source_base_role: Clean main baseline preceding workflow-only changes; worker uses the named dispatch branch head, recorded separately
stop: missing permissions or host dependencies -> BLOCKED receipt
after initial failure, at most two repair attempts then STOP
complete evidence -> STOP for Z review
lineage: Puppy Linux / Barry Kauler method credit; not designated Puppy fork or Fedora distro
objective: Build and accept twice the SAME offline x86-64 QEMU kernel+initramfs+static BusyBox minimal guest with shell and timed HELLO; Buildroot 2026.08 provisional and disposable.

spec.download_sha256: MUST VERIFY AND RECORD, NOT YET KNOWN
spec.pin: Exact kernel, BusyBox, Buildroot, archive digests, toolchain, host and configs
spec.image: Linux kernel, compressed initramfs, static BusyBox, minimal /init, serial interactive shell
spec.qemu: -nic none, no shared folders, host block devices, passthrough devices or network
spec.shell_proof: Send fresh host-generated token via shell printf; separately emitted output must match exactly, never command echo
spec.minimum_span_reason: 240s floor explicitly retired; two 115s gaps total only 230s
spec.repeat: Two complete guest runs using unchanged artifact hashes

acceptance: Pinned clean build generates real kernel and compressed initramfs; preserve manifest with exact source/tool versions/digests, commands, config
Run full shell+3 HELLO acceptance twice unchanged kernel/initramfs: log QEMU args and artifact SHA256
Both shell proofs within 90s via fresh token that is NOT command echo
Both sets of 3 HELLO records in order, first uptime <=15, guest intervals 115-125s, host arrivals 105-150s, hard watchdog 390s
128 MiB allocation recorded, not claimed to be actual resident RAM minimum
Kernel+initramfs combined bytes strictly below 100000000; report separate bytes and SHA256
Checker reject fixtures for missing HELLO, duplicate sequence, bad uptime/interval, absent or echoed shell proof and timeout
Review runtime and QEMU args for -nic none and no host/device mount access; not a security guarantee
No binaries over normal Git limits committed without artifact-storage decision
outputs: puppy-p0a/ config, build, guest init, host checker, failure fixtures
